feedback.problem: Suppose $|\,a\,|=8$ and the angle between vectors $a$ and $b$ is $\theta ={120}^{∘}.$ Find the scalar projection of $a$ onto $b.$
feedback.worked_solution:
Using the formula for the scalar projection, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{b}\,a & =|\,a\,|\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  \\  & =8\operatorname{cos}⁡({120}^{∘}) \\  & =8\cdot (-\frac{1}{2}) \\  & =-4.\end{aligned}
$$
